title: chamaecytisus austriacus
intro: Chamaecytisus austriacus, commonly known as Austrian mountain clover or Austrian broom, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of C. austriacus include acting as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and anti-hemorrhagic agent. The bioactive constituents of C. austriacus include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
